response.sql:
WITH player_counts AS (
    SELECT p.player_id, COUNT(ma.player_id) AS manager_award_count
    FROM player AS p
    LEFT JOIN manager_award AS ma ON ma.player_id = p.player_id
    GROUP BY p.player_id
), totals AS (
    SELECT SUM(manager_award_count) AS total_count
    FROM player_counts
)
SELECT pc.player_id,
       pc.manager_award_count,
       1.0 * pc.manager_award_count / NULLIF(t.total_count, 0) AS fraction
FROM player_counts AS pc
CROSS JOIN totals AS t
ORDER BY fraction DESC NULLS LAST
LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: A missing or zero total makes the fraction undefined; NULLIF returns NULL in that case, and the query still returns player rows with those fractions last.
